scope: Recorded before any fresh heldout use; all training-selected arms and failed rows remain visible
primary_quality_comparison: global operator policy versus execution-only, each task paired by fresh seed; exact McNemar for final joint train/test success with Holm across9 tasks
secondary_comparisons: CPU guard versus chosen operator; execution-only versus GPU baseline; each GPU arm versus ASGP. P-values corrected across9 tasks separately for each comparison, not across the entire exploratory family; no selective winner claim.
accuracy: per-task mean paired final test-accuracy delta; deterministic paired-seed percentile bootstrap95%,4000 resamples
speed: per-task paired ASGP search-wall/GPU search-wall, median/geomean; median paired-seed bootstrap95%; CPU guard included in search wall, posthoc CPU judges separate
missingness: all planned runs in operational yield with Wilson95%; only dual-successful audits in paired quality inference; missing rows not imputed as observed quality failures
success: final champion has wrong0 on BOTH training and test; separate gen0 champion successes, subsequent final successes and lost initial success; no test-based best generation selection
curves: training-selected champion accuracy per observed generation; seed median and IQR are descriptive, not confidence bands; first success timing retrospective only
limits: fixed9 selected tasks and one fresh data split per task; seed uncertainty is conditional on those tasks/cases, not evidence of equivalence or general task-population performance
